events.label: Наука
entries: 2020 – The Food and Drug Administration issues an Emergency Use Authorization on the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, the first COVID-19 vaccine to be approved by the agency.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1913 – More than two years after it was stolen from the Louvre, Leonardo da Vinci's painting Mona Lisa is recovered in Florence, Italy. The thief, Vincenzo Peruggia, is immediately arrested.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1946 – The United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund (UNICEF) is established.
